text: Security is an essential part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through strong passwords or two-factor methods. Input validation is equally important, because it checks the information users submit and blocks harmful content before it reaches the system. Developers must also understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which attackers often exploit. By combining these practices, developers can build safer applications and protect both user data and company reputation.
